The World Cup only comes around once every four years, so let's do it properly!

We're watching the games together. The goals, the celebrations, the heartbreak, and the completely unreasonable confidence people have in their predictions.

Join me live on YouTube throughout the tournament. ⚽🌍
Made possible with our friends at @Klarna, @firefox, and @Airbnb.
 
And thanks to @Ritzcrackers, @Keurig, and @Lovesac for helping us bring it all to life.

Is Hasan Piker the Joe Rogan of the left?


What Now? with Trevor Noah (@WhatNowPodcast)

“The left needs a Joe Rogan.”
People have been saying that for years.

So what happens when Hasan Piker gets asked directly if he’s that person?

One of the most interesting parts of the episode.

Watch the full conversation now on YouTube.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/WhatNowPodcast/status/2060428207267197040#m

The internet has taught me that the moment someone says “that’s going to be clipped,” it’s already too late. 😂

Watch the full conversation on my YouTube channel now!

Video

It's a strange feeling when you're told things are getting better... while everything around you keeps getting more expensive.

Watch the full conversation with Hasan Piker on my YouTube channel.

Is Your Job Safe?

I asked Hasan how he feels about being
called “the Joe Rogan of the left," and somehow we
ended up discussing podcast culture, political
messaging, CNN energy, elk hunting, and whether
“goon” is an acceptable adult insult. 😂

Really fascinating conversation. 

Full episode is up now on my YouTube channel.
